# scale step

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:scaleStep`](gmeow-scaleStep.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scaleStep>

The scale's granularity step, when discrete. Optional; absent means continuous.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreScale.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal); functional

Use [`gmeow:scaleStep`](gmeow-scaleStep.md) from [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreScale.md) to [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the discrete step of a score scale — a five-point scale steps by one.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it for a continuous scale (leave it absent — absence means continuous) and avoid more than one (it is functional).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:scaleStep`](gmeow-scaleStep.md) once on a [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreScale.md) only when the scale is discrete; omit it for continuous scales.

### Examples

- ex:fivePoint [`gmeow:scaleStep`](gmeow-scaleStep.md) 1.0.
